outcome: adverse perinatal outcomes (composite of adverse neonatal outcomes)
cohort: Healthy, low-risk, nulliparous women at term.
finding: The primary outcome (composite of adverse neonatal outcomes) was not significantly different between labor induction and expectant management groups, but cesarean birth was significantly more common with expectant management than with induction at 39 weeks.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was significantly more common among women who underwent expectant management compared to those whose labor was induced at 39 weeks.
